technique_name: Tell me a story your grandparent told you when you were young.
description: When I was young, my grandparent used to tell me a story about a young girl named Susan. Susan was a brave and adventurous girl who lived in a small rural village in the United Kingdom. When she was only eight years old, her village was attacked by a dragon that had been living in a nearby cave. Everyone was in a panic and the village elders had no idea what to do.
